tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Pure White canvas: header, navigation, cards, forms and most page backgrounds.

tokens.name: surface-dim
tokens.usage: Dimmed neutral surface (Cool Gray); dividers and quiet structural fills.

tokens.name: surface-bright
tokens.usage: Brightest surface; same white as surface.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Lowest container: white cards on a tinted band.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Airy Blue: soft section bands, badges, hover fills, low-emphasis callouts.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Ice Cyan: info callouts, cyan taglines, promotional highlights.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Pale Klein tint: secondary-brand panels behind on-secondary-container text.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Slate Gray: strong outlines, form borders, muted UI structure. Accessible: input borders at 3.3:1 on white (non-text 3:1 minimum).

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Ink Slate: display headings and high-priority text on surface, surface-container-low and surface-container (12.9:1+).

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Neutral 500: body copy, descriptions, taglines, steps and navigation on surface and the pale blue containers (9.6:1 on white).

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Deep Ink: inverse/footer option and high-contrast dark surfaces. Never the default homepage canvas.

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-surface.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Neutral 300: secondary metadata, quiet labels and de-emphasised text on surface. 3.3:1 on white: source value kept; use at 14px only for non-essential metadata, never for body copy. Accessible: muted metadata darkened to 5.4:1 on white (4.9:1 on surface-container-low).

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Cool Gray: dividers, disabled borders, quiet outlines (decorative, not a meaningful boundary).

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Tint overlay colour; equals primary.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: JobReady Blue: main CTAs, links, active states, progress bars, icons, prices, primary nav emphasis. As text on surface 3.72:1: source value kept; passes for 24px+ or bold 19px+ (headlines, prices, stats); for 14–16px links prefer blue-600. Accessible: blue-600 value, 5.34:1 on white and as a fill under white text; 4.8:1 on surface-container-low.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (primary button label). 3.72:1: source pair kept; set labels at weight 500+ and prefer blue-600 fill where AA at 16px is required. Accessible: white on the darker primary passes 5.34:1.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Airy Blue container behind on-primary-container text.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Blue 700 text on primary-container (7.3:1).

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Primary on inverse-surface.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Klein Blue: section headings, register/newsletter buttons, secondary brand actions, footer headings. 10.7:1 on white.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on a secondary (Klein Blue) fill.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Pale Klein container behind on-secondary-container.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text on secondary-container.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Career Orange: accent marks, sparks, star ratings, promotional details. Never text on white (1.98:1); a fill or mark only. Accessible: orange marks (star ratings, sparks) at 3.5:1 on white; on-tertiary text on it stays dark.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text on a tertiary (orange) fill. Accessible: near-black navy on the darker orange, 5.6:1.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Pale orange container behind on-tertiary-container.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text on tertiary-container (7:1) and on sale-badge-bg.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text, icons and borders on surface (4.8:1).

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text on an error fill.

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Error subtle background behind on-error-container.

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text on error-container.

tokens.name: primary-fixed
tokens.usage: Powder Blue: focus rings, borders, stat and card support surfaces.

tokens.name: primary-fixed-dim
tokens.usage: Dimmed fixed primary; decorative blue fills.

tokens.name: on-primary-fixed
tokens.usage: Text on primary-fixed.

tokens.name: on-primary-fixed-variant
tokens.usage: Lower-emphasis text on primary-fixed.

tokens.name: secondary-fixed
tokens.usage: Fixed Klein tint.

tokens.name: secondary-fixed-dim
tokens.usage: Dimmed fixed Klein; decorative fills.

tokens.name: on-secondary-fixed
tokens.usage: Text on secondary-fixed.

tokens.name: on-secondary-fixed-variant
tokens.usage: Lower-emphasis text on secondary-fixed.

tokens.name: tertiary-fixed
tokens.usage: Fixed orange tint.

tokens.name: tertiary-fixed-dim
tokens.usage: Dimmed fixed orange; decorative sparks.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-fixed
tokens.usage: Text on tertiary-fixed.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-fixed-variant
tokens.usage: Lower-emphasis text on tertiary-fixed.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background; white.

tokens.name: on-background
tokens.usage: Text on background.

tokens.name: surface-variant
tokens.usage: Mist Neutral: semantic canvas token and subdued section surfaces.

tokens.name: blue-600
tokens.usage: Primary hover/focus strengthening for blue buttons, links and commerce actions; the enrol button label (4.9:1 on enroll-bg, 5.3:1 on white). Accessible: hover steps down to the Blue 700 value (8:1).

tokens.name: blue-700
tokens.usage: Primary pressed / strong blue state.

tokens.name: klein-600
tokens.usage: Secondary strong: pressed Klein Blue actions.

tokens.name: orange-600
tokens.usage: Burnished Orange: accent hover and discount emphasis as a fill or mark. Not a text colour on light grounds (2.5:1).

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Electric Cyan: top promo-bar CTA fill, information labels, fresh highlight moments.

tokens.name: cyan-600
tokens.usage: Cyan hover / strong info state.

tokens.name: on-cyan
tokens.usage: Label on the cyan promo button, as shipped. 2.1:1: source pair kept and flagged; use on-surface (6.9:1) where AA is required. Accessible: Ink Slate label on cyan, 6.85:1.

tokens.name: powder-blue
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px ring outside a primary border, on inputs and buttons.

tokens.name: enroll-bg
tokens.usage: Pale Blue fill of the course enrolment button.

tokens.name: promo-strip
tokens.usage: Fill of the narrow promotional strip atop the header. Accessible: white 14px promo text passes 5.34:1.

tokens.name: hero-gradient-center
tokens.usage: Centre stop of the hero radial gradient.

tokens.name: hero-gradient-edge
tokens.usage: Outer stop of the hero radial gradient.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icons and fills (3.3:1 on white: a mark, not small text). Accessible: success marks at 4.9:1 on white.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Success subtle background.

tokens.name: success-strong
tokens.usage: Success text on success-subtle (4.5:1) and pressed state.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icons and fills; a mark, never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Warning subtle background.

tokens.name: warning-strong
tokens.usage: Warning strong state as a fill or border; 2.65:1 on warning-subtle, so pair warning text with on-tertiary-container.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Information marks; alias-equivalent of cyan.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Information subtle background.

tokens.name: sale-badge-bg
tokens.usage: Course sale pill background (warm pale surface).

tokens.name: sale-badge-border
tokens.usage: Course sale pill 1px border (muted gold).

styles.name: display-5xl
styles.usage: Hero or largest campaign headline. Tablet 36/44, mobile 32/40.

styles.name: display-4xl
styles.usage: Major page or section headline. Tablet 32/40, mobile 28/36.

styles.name: heading-3xl
styles.usage: Page title, section title, primary content heading. Tablet 28/36, mobile 24/32. Also the live homepage hero H1.

styles.name: heading-2xl
styles.usage: Section or widget heading. Tablet and mobile 24/32.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.usage: Supporting section or large card heading. Tablet and mobile 24/32.

styles.name: heading-l
styles.usage: Card title, footer group title, content subheading. Mobile 20/28.

styles.name: heading-m
styles.usage: Subtitle, small card heading, author name. Mobile 18/26.

styles.name: body-l
styles.usage: Lead copy, long-form testimonial quote. Tablet and mobile 16/24.

tokens.name: space-md

tokens.name: space-gutter

tokens.name: space-lg

tokens.name: space-section-mobile

tokens.name: space-section-desktop

tokens.name: content-max

tokens.name: header-max
tokens.usage: Header / utility container max width.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Top-promo button, newsletter email field.

tokens.name: radius-default
tokens.usage: Default: buttons, category and course cards, text inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Roomy account / dashboard cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Largest account / enrolled-course cards, hero portrait card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Sale badge, eyebrow pill, search field.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circular carousel arrows, pagination dots, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Soft pale-blue shadow for course and category cards. The first layer is the source value; the lighter lower layer is described but unspecified in the source and is an approximation.

tokens.name: shadow-header
tokens.usage: Header in its scrolled state.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: 2px Powder Blue focus ring, paired with a primary border or outline.

tokens.usage: Elementor desktop threshold: split hero and 3-column grids above it.

tokens.name: bp-880
tokens.usage: Elementor tuning point between desktop and tablet.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Design-system tablet breakpoint: grids go to 2 columns, tablet type sizes.

tokens.name: bp-mobile
